primary.note: Day #6366f1 / night #7681f5. The single brand accent: primary action, selection, focus.

accent-ruby.note: Used/end/danger + Illrigger summary strips. Day deepens to #dc2626.

bg-base-night.note: Default body background — the room the sheet lives in.

bg-base-day.note: Day body background — a cool near-white, chroma toward slate not warmth.

text-primary-night.note: Primary text on the dark canvas.

text-primary-day.note: Primary text on the light canvas; secondary #475569, muted #5b6675 — lifted off the AI light-gray default to clear AA.

display.purpose: Character name, page title, hero stat numerals ONLY. Never a UI label.

headline.purpose: Modal titles and major panel headings.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked micro-labels: stat labels, status-strip labels, toggle text. Uppercase at the selector.

mono.purpose: Keyboard hints, dice formulas, aligned counts.

shadows.name: ambient-rest
shadows.purpose: Section cards at rest (night). Day: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.06).

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Section cards on hover, paired with a border brighten. The only elevation change most surfaces make.

shadows.name: focus-glow
shadows.purpose: Reserved indigo halo for rare emphasized elements; not a default card treatment.

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: State-change transitions on chips, toggles, buttons (hover/active).

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Smooth ease-out for entrances. No bounce/elastic.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Snappy ease-out; used by the toast slide-in.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Confident/decisive ease-out for the most deliberate reveals.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Reference small-phone width; combat masonry collapses to one column at =768px.

breakpoints.name: desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Reference desktop width for two-column masonry + overflow checks.

components.name: Section Card
components.description: The Manager view's top-level container: one neutral card surface, hairline border, flat at rest, brightens + lifts on hover. Title uses the Cinzel display face with a 4px indigo marker.
components.html:
Combat Stats

Section content sits on the card surface. Inner blocks recess to the base tone.
components.css: .ds-section { background: var(--cs-bg-surface, #1e293b); border: 1px solid var(--cs-border, rgba(255,255,255,0.1)); border-radius: var(--cs-radius-lg, 16px); padding: var(--cs-space-lg, 24px); box-shadow: var(--cs-shadow-sm, 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)); transition: border-color var(--cs-transition-fast, 150ms), box-shadow var(--cs-transition-fast, 150ms); } .ds-section:hover { border-color: var(--cs-border-hover, rgba(255,255,255,0.2)); box-shadow: var(--cs-shadow-md, 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.3)); } .ds-section__title { font-family: var(--cs-font-display, 'Cinzel', serif); font-size: var(--cs-text-base, 1rem); font-weight: 600; color: var(--cs-text-primary, #f1f5f9); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--cs-space-sm, 8px); margin: 0 0 var(--cs-space-md, 16px); padding-bottom: var(--cs-space-sm, 8px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--cs-border, rgba(255,255,255,0.1)); } .ds-section__title::before { content: ''; width: 4px; height: 1em; background: var(--cs-primary, #6366f1); border-radius: 2px; } .ds-section__body { color: var(--cs-text-secondary, #9fadc0); line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }

components.name: Combat Section Shell
components.description: The shared chrome every class combat surface adopts: labelled region card with a themed icon, title, and a right-aligned primary-action slot. Inner grammar stays class-authored.
components.html: Sneak Attack
components.css: .ds-combat-section { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--cs-space-sm, 8px); padding: var(--cs-space-md, 16px); background: var(--cs-bg-surface, #1e293b); border: 1px solid var(--cs-border, rgba(255,255,255,0.1)); border-radius: var(--cs-radius-md, 10px); } .ds-combat-section__header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--cs-space-sm, 8px); } .ds-combat-section__icon { color: var(--cs-primary-text, #8b93f7); flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-combat-section__title { margin: 0; font-size: var(--cs-text-sm, 0.875rem); font-weight: 700; color: var(--cs-text-primary, #f1f5f9); } .ds-combat-section__actions { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--cs-space-xs, 4px); }

components.name: State Toggle
components.description: The signature stateful chip. Encodes state three ways at once: color + icon + text. ON = emerald, OFF = muted neutral, USED = ruby/disabled. Always aria-pressed.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--cs-space-xs, 4px); min-height: 24px; padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem; font-size: var(--cs-text-xs, 0.75rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; border: 1px solid var(--cs-border, rgba(255,255,255,0.1)); border-radius: var(--cs-radius-full, 9999px); background: var(--cs-bg-elevated, #334155); color: var(--cs-text-secondary, #9fadc0); cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--cs-transition-fast, 150ms), border-color var(--cs-transition-fast, 150ms), color var(--cs-transition-fast, 150ms); } .ds-toggle:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--cs-border-hover, rgba(255,255,255,0.2)); } .ds-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cs-primary, #6366f1); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-toggle--on { background: var(--cs-success-light, rgba(16,185,129,0.12)); border-color: var(--cs-success, #10b981); color: var(--cs-success, #10b981); } .ds-toggle--off { color: var(--cs-text-muted, #98a5b8); } .ds-toggle--used { background: var(--cs-danger-light, rgba(239,68,68,0.12)); border-color: var(--cs-danger, #f26161); color: var(--cs-danger, #f26161); cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-toggle:disabled { opacity: 0.8; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Status Strip
components.description: The at-a-glance summary bar (DC / pool / range / save). Full-border base-tone inset, role=group. A superseded value renders struck-through beside the current one.
components.html: Dice3d62d6Avg7
components.css: .ds-strip { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: var(--cs-space-xs, 4px) var(--cs-space-md, 16px); padding: var(--cs-space-xs, 4px) var(--cs-space-sm, 8px); background: var(--cs-bg-base, #0f172a); border: 1px solid var(--cs-border, rgba(255,255,255,0.1)); border-radius: var(--cs-radius-sm, 6px); } .ds-strip__item { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: var(--cs-space-xs, 4px); } .ds-strip__label { font-size: var(--cs-text-xs, 0.75rem); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; font-weight: 600; color: var(--cs-text-muted, #98a5b8); } .ds-strip__value { font-size: var(--cs-text-sm, 0.875rem); font-weight: 700; color: var(--cs-text-primary, #f1f5f9); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-strip__value-was { font-weight: 400; color: var(--cs-text-muted, #98a5b8); text-decoration: line-through; margin-right: 2px; }

components.name: Action Button (Primary)
components.description: Compact in-play button. The neutral base is 'reset'; verb-mapped variants (primary/spend/heal/danger/selected) carry intent. Labels stay class-authored.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--cs-space-xs, 4px); min-height: 24px; padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem; font-size: var(--cs-text-xs, 0.75rem); font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid var(--cs-border, rgba(255,255,255,0.1)); border-radius: var(--cs-radius-sm, 6px); background: var(--cs-bg-elevated, #334155); color: var(--cs-text-secondary, #9fadc0); cursor: pointer; transition: background var(--cs-transition-fast, 150ms), border-color var(--cs-transition-fast, 150ms), color var(--cs-transition-fast, 150ms); } .ds-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--cs-border-hover, rgba(255,255,255,0.2)); background: var(--cs-bg-active, rgba(255,255,255,0.1)); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cs-primary, #6366f1); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-btn__cost { opacity: 0.75; font-weight: 400; } .ds-btn--primary { background: var(--cs-primary-strong, #4f46e5); border-color: var(--cs-primary-strong, #4f46e5); color: #fff; } .ds-btn--spend { background: var(--cs-warning-light, rgba(245,158,11,0.14)); border-color: var(--cs-warning, #f59e0b); color: var(--cs-warning, #f59e0b); } .ds-btn--heal { background: var(--cs-success-light, rgba(16,185,129,0.12)); border-color: var(--cs-success, #10b981); color: var(--cs-success, #10b981); } .ds-btn--danger { background: var(--cs-danger-light, rgba(239,68,68,0.12)); border-color: var(--cs-danger, #f26161); color: var(--cs-danger, #f26161); }

components.name: Pool Caption
components.description: One canonical N / M (recharge) grammar for every resource pool. Count bold-primary, max/recharge muted, auto-red at empty. Tabular numerals; count/max spanned for screen readers.
components.html: 3/5(long rest)
components.css: .ds-pool { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 2px; font-size: var(--cs-text-xs, 0.75rem); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--cs-text-secondary, #9fadc0); } .ds-pool__count { font-weight: 700; color: var(--cs-text-primary, #f1f5f9); } .ds-pool__max, .ds-pool__recharge { color: var(--cs-text-muted, #98a5b8); } .ds-pool--empty .ds-pool__count { color: var(--cs-danger, #f26161); }

components.name: Feature Block
components.description: Recessed base-tone inset with a full 1px border — the replacement for the banned colored side-stripe block. Stacks with a sibling margin; never nests.
components.html:
Cunning Strike DC 15
Trade 1d6 of Sneak Attack for an effect.
components.css: .ds-feature { padding: var(--cs-space-sm, 8px); background: var(--cs-bg-base, #0f172a); border: 1px solid var(--cs-border, rgba(255,255,255,0.1)); border-radius: var(--cs-radius-sm, 6px); } .ds-feature + .ds-feature { margin-top: var(--cs-space-sm, 8px); } .ds-feature__title { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: var(--cs-space-xs, 4px); font-size: var(--cs-text-sm, 0.875rem); font-weight: 700; color: var(--cs-text-primary, #f1f5f9); } .ds-feature__meta { font-size: var(--cs-text-xs, 0.75rem); font-weight: 400; color: var(--cs-text-muted, #98a5b8); } .ds-feature__summary { font-size: var(--cs-text-xs, 0.75rem); color: var(--cs-text-muted, #98a5b8); margin-top: var(--cs-space-xs, 4px); }

components.name: Keyboard Hint
components.description: Monospace keyboard-shortcut chip used in help tips (e.g. Ctrl+Shift+P for Play Mode). Indigo-tinted, subtle.
components.css: .ds-help { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--cs-text-muted, #98a5b8); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-kbd { display: inline-block; background: rgba(99,102,241,0.12); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--cs-font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--cs-primary-text, #8b93f7); border: 1px solid rgba(99,102,241,0.2); } .ds-help__label { opacity: 0.7; }

narrative.overview: This is the interface for a D&D 5e character in active play: a DM and four players around a lamp-lit table, phones and laptops open mid-encounter, glancing down for two seconds to spend a resource and look back up. Every decision serves that glance. The default surface is dark because that is the room the sheet lives in; the light theme is a first-class parity mode, not the starting point. The type is quiet, the numbers are loud, and the color is rationed so that when a chip turns green or a pool turns red it means something. The system's organizing idea is a consistent shell around diverse content: D&D's classes do not share one grammar, and that diversity is intentional and correct. So the design does not flatten those grammars into one control; it wraps every class surface in the same chrome (header, status strip, ON/OFF/USED state vocabulary, roll-feedback channel, accessibility spine). One shell, many contents.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first, day-at-parity: night is the flagship, the light theme is a full token override that follows the site Day/Night selector.
Two coordinated surfaces: a dense tabbed Manager view and a stripped Play Mode ('Alt View') for the table, both on one token layer.
Rationed color: one indigo accent plus a compact semantic set; accent is for state and primary action, never decoration.
Numbers loud, chrome quiet: tabular numerals, a serif display face reserved for the hero name and big values, a humanist sans doing all UI work.
Glance-legible state: every stateful control encodes itself in color AND icon AND text.
WCAG 2.1 AA is a floor: every text token is contrast-tuned per theme, every icon has a text alternative, every toggle carries aria-pressed.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Arcane Indigo is the only brand accent. It marks primary action, current selection, and focus — nothing decorative. If two things on a screen are indigo and only one is the primary action, one is wrong.

rules.name: The Rationed-Semantic Rule
rules.body: Green means on/available/healed. Amber means spend/cost/warning. Red means used/end/danger. These four are the entire state vocabulary. A class may not introduce a fifth state color for flavor.

rules.name: The No-Stripe Rule
rules.body: The colored border-left/border-right accent stripe is forbidden — including when authored in JS style strings, where the CSS detector can't see it. State is carried by a full 1px border plus a background tint.

rules.name: The Cinzel-Is-a-Hero Rule
rules.body: Cinzel appears on the name, the page title, and big numerals — and nowhere else. It is never a button, a toggle, a chip, or a data label.

rules.name: The Tabular-Numeral Rule
rules.body: Any number that changes in play uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so it doesn't reflow as it ticks.

rules.name: The Recessed-Inset Rule
rules.body: Inner elements sit on the base background tone, not a lighter one. Nested content reads as cut into the card, never as a card-on-a-card. Nested cards are forbidden.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadow appears as a response to state (hover) — never as a permanent decoration.

dos: Do keep the game and the task in focus, not the interface.
Do ration Arcane Indigo to primary action, current selection, and focus (the One Voice Rule).
Do encode every stateful control in color AND icon AND text; give every icon a text alternative and every toggle aria-pressed.
Do wrap each class surface in the shared shell while letting its inner grammar stay whatever the class needs.
Do hold the ON / OFF / USED vocabulary; override the word only where a different word carries real game meaning, never the encoding.
Do tune every text token to clear WCAG AA in both themes; verify with an alpha-composited contrast probe, not by eye.
Do keep numbers loud (tabular numerals, weight, space) and chrome quiet.
Do reserve Cinzel for the name, title, and big numerals; use Inter for all UI.
donts: Don't use a colored border-left/border-right stripe as an accent — not even in a JS style string.
Don't nest cards. Inner content is a recessed inset on the base tone.
Don't reintroduce the per-section rainbow of gradient card tints. One neutral card surface, one accent.
Don't put the Cinzel display face on a button, toggle, chip, or data label.
Don't add a fifth state color, or use a semantic hue for decoration.
Don't animate for entertainment: no page-load choreography, no bounce/elastic easing. Motion conveys state (150-250ms, ease-out) or it doesn't ship.
Don't treat day mode as an afterthought — it is parity.
Don't reach for a modal first. Exhaust inline / progressive disclosure; when unavoidable, move focus into the dialog and restore it on close.
Don't ship muted gray body text on a tinted near-white 'for elegance' — bump toward ink until it clears 4.5:1.
